definition: to put something broken back together
description: A metal bucket stands on the tiled floor under an open kitchen sink cabinet, catching drips from the pipework above it. A young man in blue dungarees and a white t-shirt bends down and switches on the headlamp strapped to his forehead. In close-up his hands put a red adjustable wrench on the nut under the sink drain and turn it tight, with the bucket still below. He reaches up and pushes the lever of the chrome mixer tap. In the last shot he stands at the worktop grinning at the camera, headlamp on, while clean water runs from the tap into the stainless steel sink.

es.answer: Está arreglando una tubería que gotea.

es.question: ¿Qué está arreglando el hombre?
